# Senses

> Senses is a premium media discovery platform for visual and audio content. All media is CC0 — completely free to use, share, adapt, or build upon commercially with no attribution required.

## About

Senses combines two creative divisions: **SIGHT** (photos, videos, illustrations, vectors, 3D renders, GIFs) and **HEARING** (music tracks, sound effects, ambient soundscapes, lo-fi loops). The platform is built around discovery — editorial curation, mood-based browsing, trending charts, and a full-screen reel feed.

The site is built with Astro + React and served as a static site from GitHub Pages. Content is sourced from Pixabay (CC0).

## Content types

- High-resolution photos and wallpapers
- Videos and cinematic clips
- Digital illustrations, vectors, and 3D renders
- Animated GIFs
- Music tracks (various genres)
- Sound effects and ambient soundscapes
- Lo-fi and loop tracks

All content is CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) — no copyright, no attribution required, free for any use including commercial.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://senses.dhurta.org/) — Featured, trending, and personalised media
- [Explore](https://senses.dhurta.org/explore) — Filterable library with 1,000+ media items
- [Sight](https://senses.dhurta.org/sight) — Visual media hub
- [Hearing](https://senses.dhurta.org/hearing) — Audio media hub
- [Gallery Wall](https://senses.dhurta.org/gallery) — Randomised full-bleed masonry gallery
- [Reels](https://senses.dhurta.org/discover) — Full-screen vertical reel feed
- [Collections](https://senses.dhurta.org/collections) — Curated themed collections
- [Trending](https://senses.dhurta.org/trending) — Trending media charts
- [Editorial](https://senses.dhurta.org/editorial) — Editor's picks and spotlights
- [About](https://senses.dhurta.org/about) — About the platform
- [FAQ](https://senses.dhurta.org/faq) — Frequently asked questions
- [Creators](https://senses.dhurta.org/creators) — Creator programme information
- [Licensing](https://senses.dhurta.org/licensing) — CC0 licensing explained
